task: Predict whether a reported absence will last 8 hours or more

Reason for absence.note: Code 0 is outside the model's scope (always 0 hours in the data).

threshold_rule: minimise FP + 2.0 x FN on out-of-fold predictions

training.note: Deployed model is refit on train+test employees; reported test metrics come from the train-only version.

probability_note: Probabilities are the model's raw estimates; see calibration metrics in metrics.json.
limitations: Only absence events are in the data; the model cannot predict whether an absence occurs.
Built from 33 employees at one company; results are noisy and may not transfer to other workplaces or periods.
The model is statistically hard to distinguish from a reason-code-only baseline.
Reason-code labels come from public dataset documentation, not from the data file.
Associations are not causes. Not for hiring, firing or disciplinary decisions.

metadata_revision.note: Model artifact unchanged (v1.0.0, verified reproducible by retraining). Evaluation extended: pooled grouped CV, temporal check; limitations updated.
